method: Sizes from HTTP HEAD Content-Length, or the total in Content-Range of a GET with Range: bytes=0-0; no bodies downloaded. Requests sent with a Chrome UA, no Referer (page uses referrer=no-referrer), Accept-Encoding: identity and Origin: http://localhost:5173 (so "cors" reflects access-control-allow-origin). bytes = uncompressed file size. jsDelivr answers HEAD without Content-Length and its Range totals are compressed cache sizes, so jsDelivr files use the ETag / GitHub raw size.
firstScreen: true = fetched automatically at page load in the DEFAULT saved state (form=base, elite=E0, art view), with no scroll or click: the Google Fonts CSS + slices that cover page characters (upper bound, all weights), the loader preloads (base E0, base E2, alter E0 illustrations), the base avatar (non-lazy in the voice bar), and the theater auto-preload ~2.5 s after boot (spine runtime + base chibi meta + 默认 基建 model). If localStorage holds form=alter / elite=E2, the first screen instead pulls alter E2 art and the 5.9 MB dyn e2 model.

categories.fonts: Google Fonts css2 + woff2 unicode-range slices
